title: TEHRAN, October 26 - Hamid Ghanbari, deputy foreign minister for economic diplomacy made remarks on the US blockade against Iran.
text:
TEHRAN, October 26 - Hamid Ghanbari, deputy foreign minister for economic diplomacy made remarks on the US blockade against Iran."

"-------"

"SOT1, Hamid Ghanbari, deputy foreign minister for economic diplomacy (Farsi) (00:00 - 00:42): "It is natural that when pressure is applied at the borders of the southern ports [by the U.S.], other entities take over certain functions and a significant share of what the southern ports previously handled. This creates new capacities, allowing us to find both new export destinations and new import origins, and through the creative methods currently being employed, we try to meet the needs of the people as well as those of businesses and industries. Furthermore, we see that despite inflationary issues, we are not facing shortages of various goods across different sectors.""

"SOT2, Hamid Ghanbari, deputy foreign minister for economic diplomacy (Farsi) (00:43 - 01:07): "We hope that by continuing these activities and making it clear that such restrictions cannot bring the country's economy to its knees, we will be able to negotiate from a position of strength, that these restrictions will be lifted as quickly as possible, and that the capacities created during this period will remain intact and be used as assets for the growth and development of our country's economy.
